messages:
maria: Published the RCA for the 3/12 serving degradation. Link: https://redwood-internal/postmortems/1876543210-rca. TL;DR below — please review and ack if you're an owner.

maria: What happened — a KV-cache hot shard + autoscaler fallback loop caused a spike in inference latency for hosted customers. Impact window ~5-7m, some requests retried and hit slower model variants. Root cause = uneven cache shard distribution + aggressive scale-down policy.

maria: Mitigation we applied: rolled back the recent autoscaler tuning and applied an emergency eviction policy for the hot shard. Customers recovered; no data loss.

jen: Thanks for publishing. I'll pull the customer-facing summary into the comms draft.

sam: Filed immediate follow-ups: tightened autoscaler thresholds and added a short cooldown. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/patches/1234

incident-bot: Postmortem published by maria at 2026-03-23T14:12:34Z

kevin: Action item I own — kernel selection/profile path investigation to see why this workload favored the hot shard. ETA 2026-03-30.

liz: We'll need a short playbook entry for ops to recognise hot-shard symptoms. I'll pair with sam to draft.

aaron: I'll take customer outreach. Drafting a message now and will post to #customer-comms later today.

maria: Action items & checkpoints (owners + due dates):
- Kernel profiling & perf notes — kevin — 2026-03-30
- Autoscaler tuning + regression test — sam — 2026-03-26
- Customer outreach draft & send — aaron — 2026-03-24
- Ops playbook entry & runbook snippet — liz + sam — 2026-03-28
- Observability dashboard (latency by shard/model) — jen — 2026-04-02

maria: Please react with :white_check_mark: when you start/complete your item so we can track progress. We'll do a 15m sync tomorrow 11:00am PT to surface blockers — invite sent.

sam: :white_check_mark: autoscaler PR opened and smoke tests running.

kevin: :eyes: started profiling, will upload notes to the RCA thread later today.

jen: Comms draft pushed to #customer-comms, linking to the RCA and the short FAQ. Feedback welcome.

aaron: Draft sent to legal & support for review, will send to customers after signoff.

maria: Appreciate the quick responses. If anyone needs to change owner or ETA, update the list here so I can adjust the tracker. Otherwise I'll close the RCA checklist after the final verification on 2026-04-05.
